title: New Bengaluru–Goa Vande Bharat via Mangaluru (26655/26656): about 13 hours; regular runs from 15 Nov 2026 after a 13 Nov flag-off; 07:35→20:55, return 08:20→21:15; 12 stops; replaces the Mangaluru–Madgaon Vande Bharat (about an hour slower on that stretch); rail users' group says the Goa leg is too long
